simCheck.what: the Driver view's drawing of the window, headless at the Cycles field of view (1800 x 1012, 7.9 deg vertical, white HUD canvas, night env), against the trace it draws from and the Cycles outline

regCheck.method: main.js pattern=marks draws a cross at four road points (16 and 24 m ahead, 1 m left and right, on the ground) for the eye hudd tracks; dump=pgupanel pre-distorts the frame to the panel by the trace; beauty_render.py marks=1 eyeDz=... renders it through the optics from that eye over red self-lit discs at the same points (fov 30, 128 samples, 0.89 px per arcminute); cross centroid minus disc centroid is the registration error.

lutCheck.what: the eye-position-to-panel lookup table (js/lut.js, dev/export-lut.mjs -> assets/hudd_lut_<figure>.json) against the exact trace, 400 random eye positions in the eye box and directions in the window

simSwayWindowMarks.what: the simulator sway test (head ±75 mm), worst of the four window marks, mean and max over the sway, scored by the trace from the true eye

simVignette.what: the Driver view's vignette (hud.js via clip.js: 13 x 7 rays, the housing's own top on the way to the glass, the lid aperture, the mirror, the fold glass and the lit crop) at the same offsets, percent of the window reaching the eye

housingTop.what: the ray from the eye to the window's bottom centre, height where it passes the housing's rear (x = 0.567 m) against the housing's top there (1.1035 m)
